SELECT 'STG_EDS_DEP_STOPPAYMENTREGTABLE', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS_OF_DATE FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_STOPPAYMENTREGTABLE WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEP_STOPPAYMENTREGTABLE',COUNT(*),AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.DEP_STOPPAYMENTREGTABLE GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE
